name: Sunset dinner raft

seo.title: Sunset Dinner Raft, Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Sunset in the Koh Lanta mangrove on a private wooden raft, a seafood dinner by candlelight, then the glowing plankton in the dark water. From 3,900 THB.

h1: Sunset dinner on a private raft
lead: The mangrove at the end of the day, a seafood dinner by candlelight on your own wooden raft, then the plankton glowing in the dark water.
promise: Sunset, seafood dinner and glowing plankton

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

options.label: Private raft, sunset dinner
options.note: Seafood dinner and the plankton after dark.

steps.text: Check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier, then a slow cruise through the mangrove to see the wildlife and feed the monkeys.
Seafood dinner by candlelight on the raft.
Once it is dark, the plankton lights up when the water moves.
Back at the pier, and at your hotel around 20:00.

included: Hotel transfer both ways, within the Koh Lanta area
The raft for your group only

beforeYouBook.children: The raft is private, for your group only. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.

faq.a: Yes, once it is dark the plankton lights up when the water moves.

photos.alt: A table set for dinner on the wooden raft at sunset
photos.shot: The dinner table on the raft at sunset.

sources.from: affiches du partenaire du radeau (Sunrise View, Sunset Dinner) et base partenaires, déroulé du programme ; 19:00 pour le plancton déduit de « once it is dark » entre le dîner de 18:15 et le retour de 19:30 ; option reprise de la fiche Mangroves (découpage des fiches, décision de Jérémy du 11.11.2026)
